pages.name: French: Rubinstein, 4...Bd7 5.Nf3 Bc6 6.Bd3 Nd7 7.O-O Ngf6 8.Ng3
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 built on f2-f4(-f5) with a knight on f3, and plan 1 sent the g3-knight to h5 as a pawn route. Rewrote overview and plan 1; British spelling in plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: French Defense: Burn Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 had ...gxf6 with no white piece yet on f6. Rewrote plan 3 with the full move order; British spelling in overview and plans 1-2.

pages.name: French: Burn Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Bd7-e8-g6 through the king and ...Ba6; plan 1 had f4 as a standard Burn idea. Rewrote both plans; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: French Defense: Steinitz Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had f4-f5 behind the f3-knight; plan 3 used d4 as an outpost with White's pawn on it; plan 4 had ...Bd7-e8-g6 through the king. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4; British spelling in overview and plan 2.

pages.name: French: Steinitz, 5.Nf3 c5
pages.notes: Plan 2 had c3 (blocked by the c3-knight) and f4-f5 behind the f3-knight. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in overview and plan 4.

pages.name: French Defense: Steinitz Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had c3 behind the c3-knight and f4-f5 behind the f3-knight; plan 3 had ...Ba6 with Black's pawn on a6 and a White bishop on d3 that is not there. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling in overview and plan 2.

pages.name: French: Steinitz, 6.dxc5
pages.notes: Plan 1 had 'Be2/d3', which reads as a pawn move; plan 4 rerouted an f7-knight that does not exist. Rewrote plans 1 and 4.

pages.name: French: Burn, 5.Nxe4 Nbd7 6.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 1 had f4-f5 behind the f3-knight. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in overview and plan 4.

pages.name: French Defense: Classical Variation, Burn Variation, Morozevich Line
pages.notes: Plan 2 had an Nf3-g3-f5 route for a knight that is on e4 (and g1). Rewrote plan 2.

pages.name: French: Steinitz, Boleslavsky, 7...a6
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted the d7-knight to f8 where the bishop stands; plan 2 had White castling short as standard and vague c-file control. Rewrote both plans.
